notes: 20 endpoint entries across 15 route files, matching system-design §2.3 and the PRD API table. POST /api/grade-items/:id/mark-missing is the only route not in the PRD (FR-24 bulk action).
Base path is /api (existing convention), not /api/v1. Envelopes and error codes come from src/server/http.ts. No endpoint is paginated.
Decimals: input number|string ≤ 2 dp (validators/assignments.ts `decimal` pattern). Output: points and weights are fixed2 strings; computed percents are 1 dp strings or null.
Shared shapes live in api-contracts.json `components` (StudentTermResult, ReportCardSnapshotV1, Bands, …). validators/gradebook.ts and snapshot.ts should mirror them.

Contract decisions beyond system-design: PUT grade and PUT term-override return the recomputed StudentTermResult. PATCH scale isDefault:false on the current default is a VALIDATION_ERROR. The first scale created always becomes the default. mark-missing works on any source but only touches score-null rows. Report-card comments are max 1,000 chars. Unpublish reason is 1–500 chars. GET /api/report-cards mode A includes NOT_GENERATED rows.

No HTTP surface (by design) for FR-1, FR-3–FR-7, FR-41 (migration, sync hooks, seed), NFR-7/NFR-9/NFR-12 (UI, reuse and test rules). These are covered in system-design §2.1, §2.2, §2.5 and §6. Print pages call services directly (nonHttpContracts).

Stale leftovers from SH-10: artifacts/architect/threat-model-notes.json, artifacts/dev-planning/*, artifacts/dev/*, artifacts/qa/* and artifacts/ui-verification/* must be regenerated for SH-11, not reused.
